Straight answer: no, larvae themselves aren't combined in the DNA Manipulator — that machine is used to make tree seeds (Mutagen + Tree Bark + a seed you've unlocked).

Larvae get made in the **Incubator**, not the DNA Manipulator — you feed it a base larva/egg + a Mutagen + Fertilizer, and it randomly produces a new larva/fish egg/frog egg type (better variants come from higher-tier mutagens and RNG, not manual combining).

If you actually want to combine genetic material from larvae into something better, that's the **Genetic Synthesizer**: you extract traits from larvae/eggs using the Genetic Extractor, then combine 3–8 of those traits in the Synthesizer to make custom animal DNA for an Animal Shelter — that's where you get to pick species, color, pattern, size, bioluminescence, etc.

So: Incubator = make larvae/eggs. Genetic Extractor = pull traits off them. Genetic Synthesizer = combine traits into custom DNA. DNA Manipulator = tree seeds only.

A few things converge here on why they seem "nonexistent":

- Uncommon larvae only spawn in the wild once you've actually entered the **Insects stage** (7 GTi Terraformation Index) — if you're just short of that, none will appear no matter how much you search.
- People report that walking around and standing still in a spot for a few moments triggers larvae to spawn nearby — they don't populate passively, they spawn on approach. Standing on flat foundation grids makes them easier to spot since they can hide in grass/plants.
- If you're past that stage and still seeing zero, this is a known bug — the fix is save, exit to main menu, and reload the world, which frequently kicks the spawner back on.
- If reload doesn't fix it: Uncommon Larva can also be obtained by recycling Bee Larva harvested from a T2 Beehive — that's a source that doesn't require finding wild ones at all, and doesn't cost you honey since you're recycling the larvae byproduct, not the honey output.
